senses.gloss:
m. (-ङ्खः)
1 Six-fold repetition of the triliteral name of God.
2 The Sāma Veda.
3 Pleasing, agreeable.
E.
नि before उखि to go, aff. घ; it is also read न्युङ्ख.

mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं)
1 Crooked-backed, hump-backed.
2 Looking downwards.
3 Bent, crooked.
4 Convex.
m. (-ब्जः)
1 Disease, sickness, pain.
2 A sort of ladle made of Kusa grass.
n. (-ब्जं)
1 The fruit of the Kāmaraṅga, (Carambola averrhoa.)
2 A vessel used at Śrāddhas.
E.
न्युब्ज to be crooked, aff. घञ्.

m. (-ड्गः)
A sabre, a crooked sword.
E.
न्युब्ज crooked, and खड्ग a sword.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Blameable, vile, wicked, despicable.
2 Less, deficient, defective.
E.
नि before ऊन less.

f. (-ता)
1 Deficiency.
2 Inferiority.
E.
तल् added to न्यून also न्यूनत्व.

mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि)
Ignorant, foolish.
E.
न्यून and धी intellect.

m. (-वः)
An ideot.
E.
न्यून, and पञ्चाशत् fifty, भाव property, having but forty-nine properties of human nature.

mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं)
Maimed, mutilated, imperfect.
E.
न्यून, and अङ्ग body.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Unequal, more or less.
E.
न्यून, and अधिक more.

m. (-गः)
Unequal partition.
E.
न्यूनाधिक, and विभाग division.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Imperfect, wanting some organ; as blind, deaf, &c.
E.
न्यून, and इन्द्रिय an organ of sense.
